records.title: 10-Q
records.text: In the three months ended March 31, 2024, we generated $254.6 million in total revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The revenue mix for the three months ended March 31, 2024 was: cloud subscriptions 30%; software license 1%; maintenance 14%; services 52%; and hardware 3%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our international revenue was approximately $83.7 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024, which represents approximately 33% of our total revenue for the three months ended March 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our R&D expenses were $35.0 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2024, we generated cash flow from operating activities of $54.7 million.
